<description>
Part of #36692: remove test state that is shared and modified across cases.

- `script_combineSigs`: The P2PKH, P2SH and multisig cases shared one funding transaction, whose `scriptPubkey` was modified between them, and one keystore. Each case is now its own test with its own keys, keystore and funding transaction.
- `spends_witness_prog`: every output type reused the same transactions and coins view. The P2SH-wrapped cases relied on the `scriptPubkey` left by the previous case and had to clear the `scriptSig` they set. Each check now builds fresh state, and the scripts are named.

The checks are unchanged.
</description>

<commits>
d139d58694 test: split script_combineSigs into independent test cases

The P2PKH, P2SH and multisig cases shared one funding transaction, whose
scriptPubKey was modified between them, and one keystore.

Give each case its own test with its own keys, keystore and const
funding transaction. The checks are unchanged.

85497da71e test: use independent state for each spends_witness_prog check

The test reused funding transaction, spending transaction and coins view
for every output type, modifying them between checks. The P2SH-wrapped
cases relied on the scriptPubkey left by the previous case, and each one
had to clear the scriptSig it set.

Build fresh transactions and a fresh coins view for each check and name
the scripts each case uses. The scripts are unchanged.
</commits>
